chunks: Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who married a slave-girl, then had intercourse with her and caused ifḍāʾ to her. He said: “He must provide for her as long as she remains alive.”

key_terms.جَارِيَةً: a slave-girl; here, a female bondwoman taken in marriage
key_terms.فَأَفْضَاهَا: he caused ifḍāʾ to her; a severe bodily injury resulting from intercourse
key_terms.مَا دَامَتْ حَيَّةً: for as long as she remains alive

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a husband injures his wife through intercourse and causes ifḍāʾ?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man who causes severe bodily injury to his wife through intercourse. The Imam عليه السلام states that he is obligated to maintain her for the rest of her life, indicating an ongoing financial liability arising from the harm he caused.
